answer: Require every identity to post a refundable bond, released only after a live check seeded by a public randomness beacon. The beacon publishes an unpredictable value shortly before the window opens, so answers cannot be pre-written in bulk; each identity must respond in real time. A bridge contract locks one bond per identity and slashes it when juries catch copied work. A genuine agent pays once, while a Sybil operator must fund, bridge, and babysit a separate bond for every fake — like cutting a separate opal for each forgery — so cost grows with every identity and mass fakery stops paying.
